chunks: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Al A‘ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, who said:

I heard Abu Ja‘far (عليه السلام) saying: Every one who professes the religion of Allah through worship, exerting himself in it, while there is no Imam for him from Allah, then his striving is not accepted, and he is astray and confused, and Allah disdains his deeds. His likeness is the likeness of a sheep that has strayed from its shepherd and its flock.

So it rushes about, going and coming throughout its day. Then when the night covers it, it sees a flock with a shepherd other than its own. It inclines toward it and is deceived by it, so it spends the night with it in its fold. Then when the shepherd drives his flock on, it does not recognize its shepherd and its flock, so it rushes about in confusion seeking its shepherd and its flock. Then it sees sheep with their shepherd, inclines toward them, and is deceived by them. So the shepherd cries out to it: Join your own shepherd and your flock, for you are wandering, confused, away from your shepherd and your flock.

So it rushes off frightened, confused, and scattered, with no shepherd to guide it to its pasture or return it. While it is in that state, the wolf seizes the opportunity of its isolation and devours it. Likewise, by Allah, O Muhammad, whoever from this community begins the day without an Imam from Allah, Mighty and Majestic, manifest and just, begins the day astray and wandering; and if he dies in that state, he dies a death of disbelief and hypocrisy.

And know, O Muhammad, that the imams of tyranny and their followers are surely removed from the religion of Allah. They have gone astray and led others astray. So their deeds which they do are like ashes upon which the wind blows fiercely on a stormy day; they have no power over anything of what they earned. That is the far error.

key_terms.أَئِمَّةَ الْجَوْرِ: leaders of oppression and tyranny who misguide others
key_terms.إِمَامَ: a divinely appointed leader whose guidance is necessary in religion
key_terms.غَيْرُ مَقْبُولٍ: not accepted by Allah despite outward effort
key_terms.كُفْرٍ: disbelief, mentioned here regarding the state of dying without rightful guidance
key_terms.مُتَحَيِّرٌ: confused and unable to find correct guidance
key_terms.نِفَاقٍ: hypocrisy, paired with disbelief in describing that state

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Baqir (عليه السلام) say about worship without an Imam from Allah?
ai.summary: This hadith states that worship and religious striving are not accepted without rightful divine guidance through an Imam from Allah. It likens such a person to a lost sheep, wandering in confusion and vulnerability, and warns that following unjust leaders leads to misguidance and the nullification of deeds.
